takeaways.label: Order intake doubled YoY to over \$1 bn
takeaways.text: Q2 order intake surged 102% YoY and 51% QoQ, with a record eight large deals signed, providing strong growth visibility from a \$2.4 bn next-12-month executable order book.

takeaways.label: Margin guidance raised on AI-led efficiencies
takeaways.text: FY27 consolidated EBIT margin guidance was upgraded from 15.5% to 16%, with Q4 exit targeted at 17%, driven by AI infusion in delivery, G&A productivity, and operating leverage.

takeaways.label: Encora integration on track, parity expected
takeaways.text: Encora revenue was flat QoQ as expected, but management anticipates it will mirror Coforge's growth from Q3 onwards, with synergy benefits already visible in margin expansion and large-deal momentum.

takeaways.label: AI is breaking the scale-margin link, per management
takeaways.text: The firm argues AI-led efficiencies in fixed-price contracts and internal functions are delinking margin profile from scale, a structural shift it intends to ride aggressively while keeping growth the top priority.

watch.label: What to watch next quarter
watch.text: Whether the promised eight or more large deals materialize in the seasonally shortest quarter, the pace of Encora's revenue catch-up, and the trajectory of EBIT margin toward the 17% Q4 exit.

points.label: Record quarter
points.text: Eight large deals were signed in Q2, the highest ever in a single quarter, with most being sole-sourced and driven by proactive solutions rather than competitive RFPs.

points.label: Broad-based surge
points.text: The \$1 bn+ intake was split across Americas (\$455M), Europe (\$485M), and Rest of World (\$101M), spanning BFSI (2 large deals), public sector (3), high-tech (2), and retail (1).

points.label: Proactive strategy shields margins
points.text: Management explicitly ties its ability to sustain both growth and margin to leading with proactive solutions, avoiding pricing battles in procurement-driven RFPs where demand has slowed.

points.label: Deal ramp-ups near immediate
points.text: Most recently signed large deals are expected to begin ramping almost immediately, supporting a robust near-term growth outlook.

points.label: Encora pipeline contribution
points.text: The largest deal currently in the company's pipeline is with an Encora client, with a win hoped for in Q3 or Q4.

quotes.text: Sudhir Singh: "We've realized that in the intense pricing atmosphere that prevails across our industry, the only way to sustain both growth and margin simultaneously is to make sure that we lead with proactive solutions through an exceptional solutioning on-site engine that we have and close deals without getting into fisticuffs with other providers around pricing."

points.label: Guidance raised
points.text: FY27 consolidated EBIT margin guidance moved to 16% from 15.5%, with Q2 already delivering 16% and the standalone business hitting 17%.

points.label: Q4 exit at 17%
points.text: Management plans to achieve a reported Q4 EBIT of 17%, establishing a glide path for further expansion in FY28, with a commitment to deliver at least 17% next year.

points.label: Three efficiency levers
points.text: Margin improvement is driven by AI-led efficiencies in fixed-price contracts (reflecting in Q4), G&A productivity gains (G&A improved to 6.3% from 6.6% QoQ), and operating leverage from largely fixed intangible amortization.

points.label: Gross margin spike expected
points.text: A material spike in consolidated gross margin is expected starting Q4, if not Q3, as AI-infused delivery benefits begin reflecting in numbers.

points.label: G&A to shrink further
points.text: Management intends to continue aggressively reducing G&A through AI injection, noting G &A grew only 15.6% while revenue grew 53% YoY because technology infusion eliminated the need to hire more people in support functions.

points.label: Top-three margin ambition
points.text: The firm intends to be among the top three highest EBIT margin tech services firms in the industry in the short to medium term.

quotes.text: Sudhir Singh: "We believe that AI is breaking the link between scale and margin leadership for the tech services industry."

points.label: Margin ahead of plan
points.text: Encora's margin expansion is running ahead of the original acquisition plan, with synergy benefits on the cost side already clear.

points.label: Revenue parity from Q3
points.text: Encora revenue was sequentially flat in Q2 (~\$147-148M), on expected lines, but is expected to mirror Coforge's growth rate starting Q3 and continuing through FY28.

points.label: Deal momentum building
points.text: The integration of Encora's capabilities within the wider Coforge ecosystem is helping differentiate the combined entity and drive large-deal momentum, with the largest deal in the company's arsenal today coming from the Encora stable.

points.label: Healthcare anchor
points.text: One of the most storied names in healthcare, now Coforge's largest healthcare account, came through Encora and is expected to grow very fast.

points.label: Nearshore capability
points.text: The acquisition has built up nearshore delivery capability across Eastern Europe and LATAM.

points.label: Integration costs
points.text: Total acquisition-related exceptional costs are ~\$17M vs the \$15-16M guided, with the overrun attributed to tax planning for overseas entities and rationalization of 95 legal entities; no exceptional expenses are expected in Q3.

quotes.text: John Robert Speight: "We see ourselves as stealing a march on much of the competition."

points.label: Enterprise autonomy suite
points.text: Nuuron, launched in July, connects enterprise knowledge, workflows, and decisions in one intelligence layer, while Momentuum Blue provides a forward-deployed engineer unit supported by Mod Squads to accelerate AI time-to-value.

points.label: Open-weight AI ecosystem
points.text: The recently announced AI Launchpad helps clients select, adapt, govern, and deploy open-weight models at scale.

points.label: Partnership expansion
points.text: Coforge joined the AWS Forward Deployed Engineer pilot in September, with AWS investing to grow that footprint, and expanded its Pega partnership to build and deliver Pega-powered offerings under its own brand.

points.label: Engagement scale
points.text: The firm now has 520+ AI engagements across 225+ clients, with 260+ agents in live operations.

points.label: Margin impact from existing work
points.text: AI-driven margin uptick is currently visible in existing fixed-price projects where AI is being infused, not from anticipated future projects at better pricing.

points.label: Demand shift underway
points.text: While procurement-driven RFPs have slowed, the intensity of client demand around delivering AI-led transformation is only getting stronger.

quotes.text: Sudhir Singh: "The demand slowdown that we are talking about is largely on account of the fact that the procurement-driven RFPs have slowed down. The intensity of the ask around delivering AI-led transformation for enterprises is only getting stronger."

rows: Grew 8.3% sequentially, supported by two large deals in the quarter.
Grew 20.8% sequentially, with three large deals including a \$230M UK public sector win signed in July 2026.
Declined 6.4% sequentially, though healthcare is called out as the most promising vertical for the firm going forward.
Second client crossed \$100M annualized run rate; top 10 and top 20 accounts growing 20%+ YoY.

points.label: Free cash flow
points.text: FCF to PAT was 89% for Q2 and 92% for H1, with full-year FY27 expected at 100%.

points.label: OCF conversion dip explained
points.text: The decline in OCF to EBITDA conversion was caused by legal entity rationalization, with contracts being novated from the U.S. to India post-Encora acquisition, leading to delays in invoicing and collections and an increase in unbilled receivables.

points.label: Hedge loss tailwind
points.text: Hedge losses of \$10.2M in Q2 are expected to decline significantly to \$7.1M in Q3 and \$1.2M in Q4, providing a material EPS tailwind in the second half.

points.label: S&M aligned with growth
points.text: S&M expenses grew 52% YoY, in line with revenue growth of 53%, with no reduction in front-end sales, solutioning architects, or presales teams.

points.label: EPS trajectory
points.text: Per management, EPS could touch around INR 19 to INR 20 in Q4, driven by the combination of hedge losses declining, exceptional expenses going to zero, and EBIT margin expansion to 17%.

quotes.text: Sudhir Singh: "We continue to be the firm that prioritizes growth over everything else. It's just that at the current point in time, with the advent of AI, we believe there is an opportunity also to materially delink margin profile from scale, and we will ride that wave. But growth is the first, second and the third imperative."

items.title: Encora acquisition
items.text: Completed 23 April 2026 at US$2.35Bn enterprise value, funded by a share swap plus a US$550M facilities agreement at a fixed 4.6% interest rate, with a QIP of up to US$550Mn being considered as a funding option; Encora brings ~US$600Mn FY26 revenue at ~19% EBITDA and is expected to be EPS accretive in FY27. Integration is ahead of plan - G&A cut to 6.3% of revenue by Q2 FY27, integration costs ~$17M, and Encora's largest client already has a path to $50M+ over 12-18 months.

items.title: Record order book
items.text: Q2 FY27 saw eight large deals, the most ever in a quarter, with intake above $1 billion (up 102% YoY) and the next-12-month executable order book at an all-time high $2.38-2.4B, up ~45% YoY. New large deals ramp up "near immediate in most cases", so this backlog converts to revenue quickly and underpins management's expectation of a third straight year as industry growth leader.

items.title: AI platform monetization
items.text: Over 520 AI engagements across 225 clients with 260+ agents in live production, eight platforms including Nuuron and Quasar, and outcome-based contracts already at 6-7% of global revenues. AI-led engineering, data and cloud contributed 86% of consolidated revenue in Q2 FY27, and management sizes the addressable tech-services AI market at $160-180B growing 35%+.

items.title: Cigniti merger cross-sell
items.text: The 1:1 merger closed on Thursday, April 30, 2026; the acquired business's EBITDA margin rose from 11% to 19% in five quarters, and its top two clients grew from $25M to $75M combined annual revenue. Cigniti signed its first two large deals ever ($24M and $62M) within nine months of acquisition, and two of its top three clients have signed large deals with Coforge - a repeatable cross-sell engine.

items.title: UK public sector wins
items.text: A US$230M multi-year UK public sector digital modernization contract signed July 2026, with ramp-up already initiated and 20-30 teams to be added, on top of the US$158M five-year UK deal now fully ramped at 300+ FTEs. Government outside India grew 43.8% YoY in Q2 FY27 and three of the quarter's eight large deals were public sector, making this the fastest-compounding vertical.

items.title: Healthcare and Hi-Tech scale-up
items.text: The vertical grew 169.7% YoY in Q2 FY27, as Encora roughly doubled the healthcare book to ~$170-175M. The Innovaccer platinum partnership adds a healthcare AI Center of Excellence and jointly pursued large deals across a 54M+ patient-record platform.

items.title: Momentuum Blue margin lift
items.text: The forward-deployed engineer unit, launched July 2026 with pods already inside global enterprises, pairs elite engineers with Mod Squads under outcome-based pricing. Management expects a material spike in consolidated gross margin starting Q3-Q4 FY27 as this onsite FDE "factory" scales.

items.title: Kraków nearshore hub
items.text: The Poland engineering center has grown to 375+ engineers with 20,000 sq ft added, targeting 660+ professionals by 2027, serving travel, banking and retail clients across Europe. It extends the Encora-built nearshore footprint in Eastern Europe and LATAM, supporting the Europe-heavy large deal flow at competitive cost.

items.t: Top three EBIT margin tech services firm — short to medium term
items.txt: At the Q2 FY27 call, management said it intends to be within the top three highest EBIT margin tech services firms in the industry in the short to medium term. Q2 FY27 EBIT margin was 16.0%, and no industry comparison is yet available.

items.t: Gross margin — material spike in Q3 or Q4 FY27
items.txt: At the Q2 FY27 call, management said a material spike in consolidated gross margin should be visible "if not in Q3, starting Q4" FY27. Q3 FY27 outcome is not yet available.

items.t: Encora client — $50 million-plus account in 12–18 months
items.txt: At the Q1 FY27 call, management said one Encora-origin client in the top 10 has a path to a $50 million-plus account over the next 12 to 18 months. In Q2 FY27 a second client crossed a $100 million annualized run rate; the specific client's progression is not explicitly disclosed.

items.t: Working capital cycle — closer to 50 days
items.txt: At the Q3 FY26 call, the CFO committed to a working capital cycle closer to 50 days. The Q3 FY26 cycle was 49 days, and net working capital days came down further in Q1 FY27.
At the Q2 FY26 call, management guided free cash flow to PAT of around 70–80%. Actuals exceeded the range every quarter — 86% in Q2 FY26, 110% in Q3 FY26, 95.3% in Q1 FY27 and 89% in Q2 FY27.
At the Q1 FY27 call, management set a FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin outlook of 20.5% to 21%, confirmed at Q2 FY27. H1 FY27 EBITDA margin came in at 20.5% — at the lower end of the range.

items.t: Q3 FY27 large deals — eight or more
items.txt: At the Q2 FY27 call, management hoped to sign eight or more large deals in Q3 FY27. Q3 FY27 outcome is not yet available.

items.t: No other acquisition using equity dilution
items.txt: At the Q4 FY24 call, management committed future M&A would be via debt or internal accruals. The Encora acquisition was financed with $1.89 billion via share swap plus a term loan.

flags.intro: Seven years of unqualified audit opinions and clean CARO clauses on fraud, wilful default and fund diversion. Three things deserve attention: a data-breach class action (₹44.5 crore legal costs taken as an exceptional item in FY2026), an off-balance-sheet NCI put liability left out of the company's own net-debt narrative, and exceptional items that route material amounts around operating profit.

items.t: Promoter exit completed; board and KMP turnover accelerated sharply in FY2026
items.txt: Promoter Hulst B.V. was reclassified to public effective 8 January 2025; promoter holding is now zero. The Board met 15 times in FY2026 vs 7 in FY2023. A special resolution on SSPA rights failed on 27 January 2026 (68.84% in favour), then passed with 99.76% on 28 February 2026 after changes. Advent nominees joined the Board on 23 April 2026.

items.t: Data-breach class action and disputed tax demands
items.txt: A class action relates to a security incident at a customer database; the company disputes responsibility and took ₹44.5 crore of legal costs as an exceptional item in FY2026. Disputed income-tax demands were ₹74.1 crore and other contingent liabilities ₹35.5 crore (March 2025); the NCLT order noted ₹304.77 crore of outstanding tax demands on the ITD portal.

items.t: Settled SEBI insider-trading case and an NSE warning letter
items.txt: SEBI's procedural-lapse matter was settled without admitting or denying charges in FY2021. NSE issued a warning letter on 29 July 2024 for short notice of an analysts' call. The company states no material regulatory penalties in the last three years.

watch: USD 550 million secured term loan, maturing three years from 23 April 2026, with substantially all assets pledged, while Encora is integrated.
Outstanding tax demands of ₹304.77 crore with pending assessment and penalty proceedings.
North America client indemnification claims of USD 7.6–11.9 million, which the company said it intends to refuse.
flags.bottom: A disclosed and audited record. The risk sits in goodwill that has grown from ₹3,843 crore to ₹4,167.1 crore (no impairment so far), an off-balance-sheet NCI put liability, and a pattern of exceptional items. Watch the loan servicing, the tax demands and the next impairment test.
